title: Light Silky Turkish Bok Choi Kofte
description: A diabetic friendly Turkish dish featuring sashimi cut bok choi in a silky kofte form, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, chopped onion, minced garlic, Turkish spice mix, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the sashimi cut bok choi to the bowl and mix gently until the bok choi is evenly distributed.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small kofte, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each kofte.
Drizzle the olive oil over the kofte and gently roll them to coat evenly.
Bake the kofte in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kofte are baking, combine the lemon juice and chicken broth in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
To serve, place the kofte in a Korean brass bowl and spoon the silky sauce over the top.
